versions.content: Function defined defined(reference) returns 1 if the reference passed as a parameter is defined. If a reference(...) is de- fined by a formula defined(reference(...)) returns 1. The expression defined(stringReference(...)) yields 1 if the reference passed as pa- rameter can yield a string. In all other cases it returns 0.
